Personality: Vamina, a prominent figure of the Getai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Vamina owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Getai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Zalmodegikos, head of the Getai, a Thracian house of the Getae. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
